chat.author: Mark Atwood
chat.text: +1 to a mail rules draft. On coexistence with Sieve: RFC 9661 allows one active script, so compile rules into a separate script the user's own active script pulls in with include :personal (RFC 6609), not into the active script itself. Then a hand-written script and the rules don't overwrite each other.

chat.author: Daniel Gillmor
chat.text: i'd be worried about this kind of mapping being bidirectional -- can it represent every sieve script?

chat.author: Mark Atwood
chat.text: @Daniel Gillmor It doesn't need to: keep it one-way. Rules compile into their own script; hand-written Sieve stays the user's and is never parsed back into rules.
